news.text: ⏱️ "These are crucial hours for the future of Mattia #Perin.Between today and the weekend, it will be defined whether #Palermo has the financial capacity to afford his signing on a permanent basis.The goalkeeper has a contract with #Juventus until 2027, but the Sicilian club dreams of incorporating him into their ambitious project."[@MatteMoretto and @FabrizioRomano on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

🤝🔚 "#Juventus has reached an agreement with #Arthur for the termination of his contract. The decision to proceed with the separation was requested by the player, who has expressed the desire to find a financial solution in order to be able to move to a new club quickly."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇨🇮⏳ "#Kessié has an important offer from #AlIttihad, which is pushing. #Juventus must decide, they have had him in their grasp for two months and hoping to wear the bianconero shirt. The Saudi club has made an offer and wants to close the matter, whether positive or negative, within a few days. The Ivorian even today said to wait for la Vecchia Signora, but the matter is linked to exits and #Arthur is not enough."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

#Kessie continues to give priority to #Juve.[Eleonora Trotta]

#AlIttihad's relaunch for Franck #Kessie is an offer of 10 million for one season, with an option for the second. He has always wanted to wait for #Juventus, but now something is changing in his ideas.@Sportmania_24[Michele De Blasis]
#Kessie-#Juventus: this line anticipated last night is totally confirmed. Until he feels like waiting. And for now, he is doing so, even though #AlIttihad has relaunched.[Alfredo Pedullà]

#Juventus are still interested in Frank #Kessie as a free agent. Offered a contract until 2028 (€4M/year + bonuses). The ivorian midfielder has given his availability to join #Juve, which are working to sell two midifelders to sign him. Coach #Spalletti appreciate him a lot[Nico Schira]

🏟❌ The traditional pitch invasion in the family friendly match will no longer be allowed starting from next year, but the celebration will not be canceled. The main update is about security: the measures of an official match will be used and there will no longer be an invasion. #Gatti's injury and the damage to the structure, valued at around €50,000, prompted #Juventus to make this decision.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
🚨 #AlIttihad 🇸🇦 is launching a new attempt for Franck #Kessié in the hope of getting the green light from the midfielder and his agent.[Gianluigi Longari]

Mateo #Retegui will not leave #AlQadisiyya this year: the Saudis will play in the Asian Champions League and do not want to deprive themselves of one of their most important players. No return to Italy and above all no link to #Juventus.@Sportmania_24[Michele De Blasis]

GJustjuve .@juventusfc, Franck #Kessie has given priority to become a bianconero. First some exits are needed. [Di Marzio] https://t.me/GJustjuve/71567👀 #Juventus continues to look for a new midfielder to make available to Luciano #Spalletti.The name that rings the hardest is Franck #Kessié.The Ivorian midfielder has given priority to the bianconeri and at the moment is not exploring any other offers.The harmony he has with #Massara, dating back to their #Milan days, is proving decisive.However, to get to the final push, #Juve will need to let #Arthur leave, he could rescind his contract tomorrow, and another exit in that position.[@DiMarzio via @PuebloJ]
.@juventusfc, Franck #Kessie has given priority to become a bianconero. First some exits are needed.[Di Marzio]

🚨🇧🇷 Juventus and Arthur Melo are set to part ways by terminating the contract on mutual agreement.Financial agreement almost done after the Brazilian midfielder asked to leave to try new chapter as free agent.[Fabrizio Romano]

👀 "At this moment, #AtléticoMadrid is meeting with #Chelsea for Nicholas #Jackson.If the Spanish club signs the Senegalese forward, this could reopen the door for #Juventus to go after Alexander Sørloth; provided they find an exit for Jonathan #David."[@NicoSchira on the YouTube channel of @tuttosport via @PuebloJ]

😬 "The midfield situation of #Juventus is delicate in terms of numbers and quality.Adding that Khephren #Thuram's condition worries the club, and not just a little bit; he is training with the group but he missed the entire pre-season, it is possible that #Juve will spend another season without constantly counting on the Frenchman."[@antoniocorsa on the YouTube channel of @ilbianconerocom via @PuebloJ]
✅‼️#JNextGen, Francesco #Verde toward staying. For Javier #GilPuche, there is interest from #JuveStabia and other Serie B clubs.[Mirko Di Natale]

🧤⁉️ "#Perin is reflecting on #Palermo. On #DiGregorio, yesterday, there was a contact with #Lazio and #Juventus inquired about the situation related to #Mandas, whom they had followed in the past. Let's see, because he didn't start his season well as a starter and perhaps there is no absolute certainty or confidence from the biancoceleste club to bet on him."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
